mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE cp.child_id = #{childId} AND cp.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT auto_transfer_schedule_id AS autoTransferScheduleId, child_id AS childId, member_id AS memberId, request_idempotency_key AS requestIdempotencyKey, financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, source_account_id AS sourceAccountId, destination_account_id AS destinationAccountId, amount, frequency, transfer_day AS transferDay, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, next_transfer_at AS nextTransferAt, last_transfer_status AS lastTransferStatus, last_transferred_at AS lastTransferredAt, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM auto_transfer_schedule WHERE request_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS financialAccountId, fa.owner_type AS ownerType, fa.owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId, fa.child_id AS childId, fa.account_product_type AS accountProductType, fa.account_status AS accountStatus, fa.link_status AS linkStatus, fg.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId FROM financial_account fa LEFT JOIN financial_goal fg ON fg.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id AND fg.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_transfer_schedule ( child_id, member_id, request_idempotency_key, financial_goal_id, source_account_id, destination_account_id, amount, frequency, transfer_day, start_date, end_date, next_transfer_at, last_transfer_status, last_transferred_at, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{memberId}, #{requestIdempotencyKey}, #{financialGoalId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{destinationAccountId}, #{amount}, #{frequency}, #{transferDay}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{nextTransferAt}, NULL, NULL, 'ACTIVE', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
